summary: The feature-parity validator exempts a dependency-only bump, as it already exempts npm version: every changed file is a package.json or package-lock.json (root or apps/mobile), and every changed package.json line is a "name": "<version range>" pair. Dependabot pull requests no longer need a manifest. A change to a script, a path or any other field still does.

desktop.reason: A CI policy script changes; no app code.

reactNativeIos.reason: Same: policy script only. apps/mobile dependency bumps are what the exemption covers.

nativeAndroid.reason: Policy script only; Gradle dependency bumps are not package.json changes and are unaffected.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No wire protocol or backend change.

automated: tests/unit/feature-parity-policy.test.ts covers a lockfile-only change, a dependency range change, an npm: alias, a script change, a main path change, a mixed diff, an empty diff, a failed git and a missing base.
npm run validate:feature-parity -- --base origin/main passes on this branch.
notExercised: A live dependabot pull request after this merges (#333 and #334 are the first).
